narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the log file.
finalText:
**`Redis` died and took prod down with it.**

| Time | What |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `Redis` at `10.0.0.12:6379` refused connects [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182) |
| 02:14:08 | Cache bypassed. Reads went straight to store. |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passed its 500 max |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | `api` killed by supervisor. Service down. |

13 reconnect tries failed, all `ECONNREFUSED`. 173 timeouts followed.

One catch. The log dates read 2026-07-04, not last night.

Next: find why `Redis` refused every connect.
